title: Irish Potato Hash
description: A simple, comforting potato dish from Ireland made with old, fashioned Irish potatoes, pan-fried to perfection.
instructions: Boil the potatoes in a large pot of salted water until they are tender.
Drain the potatoes and let them cool slightly.
Heat the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced potatoes and cook until they are golden brown and crispy.
Stir in the Irish hash, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Garnish with chopped parsley before serving.
